scripts.build: bun --filter @ui-library/tokens build && bun --filter @ui-library/react build && bun --filter @ui-library/react-native build
scripts.check: bun run build && bun --filter @ui-library/react typecheck && bun --filter @ui-library/react-native typecheck && bun --filter @ui-library/preview typecheck && bun --filter @ui-library/docs typecheck && bun test
scripts.preview: bun --filter @ui-library/tokens build && bun --filter @ui-library/react build && bun --filter @ui-library/preview start
scripts.docs: bun --filter @ui-library/tokens build && bun --filter @ui-library/react build && bun --filter @ui-library/docs start
scripts.release: bun run check && bun x --bun changeset publish
